arguments.content:
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from collections import OrderedDict

wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)
ws = wb['Budget']

cats = OrderedDict()
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=11, max_row=22, min_col=1, max_col=3):
    cat, item, amount = row[0].value, row[1].value, row[2].value
    if amount is not None:
        cats.setdefault(cat, 0)
        cats[cat] += amount

grand_total = sum(cats.values())
for cat, total in cats.items():
    print(f"{cat}: {total}")
print(f"TOTAL EXPENSES: {grand_total}")

import sys
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'budget.xlsx'
wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
print('sheets:', wb.sheetnames)
for ws in wb.worksheets:
    print(f'--- sheet={ws.title!r} dims={ws.dimensions} rows={ws.max_row} cols={ws.max_column}')
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        vals = [(c.coordinate, c.value) for c in row if c.value is not None]
        if vals:
            print(vals)
